analytics.name: Analytic 1646
analytics.guidance: Defender correlates an app enumerating installed packages (PackageManager queries or shell 'pm list packages') with selective checks for high-value targets (banking/identity/security apps) and near-term persistence/egress of the inventory. Chain: capability to query apps → burst of enumeration calls or shell listing → optional foreground target detection → local inventory file → small POST to remote endpoint.

tuning.description: Max time from enumeration to persist/exfil (e.g., 10–120s).
Minimum count of package queries or listed rows to treat as inventory (e.g., ≥50).
List of sensitive app package prefixes (banking/IdP/AV/MDM) to raise severity.
Regex for inventory artifacts in the app container.
Known-good analytics/CDN endpoints to suppress FPs.
Work Profile/Kiosk/Jamf/Intune policy context to scope benign inventory jobs.

log_sources.name: android:logcat
log_sources.channel: PackageManager getInstalledApplications|getInstalledPackages|getPackagesHoldingPermissions burst for <pkg>. TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED shows foreground app then immediate package queries by <pkg>

log_sources.name: android:logcat
log_sources.channel: Command 'pm list packages' executed by app sandbox or child proc

analytics.name: Analytic 1647
analytics.guidance: Defender correlates attempts to inventory installed apps via LaunchServices/URL-scheme probing or private APIs (e.g., LSApplicationWorkspace) with checks for high-value targets and quick persistence/egress. Chain: capability/attempt (URL scheme spray or LSWorkspace calls) → large scheme/app probe set → optional webview hits to brand domains → local inventory cache → small egress.

tuning.description: Max time from probe burst to persist/exfil (e.g., 10–120s).
Minimum count of scheme/app probes to treat as inventory (e.g., ≥40).
Regex for inventory artifacts in container.
Allowlist of enterprise analytics/CDN to reduce FPs.
Flag to escalate if private APIs appear on non-managed devices.

log_sources.name: iOS:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: LSApplicationWorkspace or canOpenURL probe bursts for many URL schemes
